source.name: Minecraft Circle Litematics
source.purpose: Real binary Litematica parser regression fixture; not production building geometry

notes: Litematica v5 Regions/BlockStatePalette/BlockStates were decoded from real gzip-NBT files.
Dynamic entities are ignored by design.

Planet Minecraft public-domain building pages were re-verified, but their binary download endpoint was not directly retrievable in this run; the pipeline switched to a CC0 GitHub binary fixture rather than stopping.
Final building delivery still requires at least three visual QA passes after realistic exterior conversion.
